UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 7, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Naiomi Rainey, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Gina Maguire, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Secretary

Christopher J. Garner, General Manager  Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52415  Recommendation to approve February 15, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52416  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute the Second
  Amendment to Agreement WD-3709 with 3D Built, for the Ground Water Treatment
  Plant (GWTP) Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Project (EO-
  3500), for an additional amount of $125,000, to a new contract total amount not to
  exceed $954,130.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52417  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1511 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute a contract, and any necessary subsequent amendments, with Ferguson
  Enterprises, LLC dba Ferguson Facilities Supply, to furnish and deliver as-needed
  plumbing supplies, on the same terms and conditions afforded to the County of
  Orange, in a total annual amount not to exceed $1,500,000 until the County of
  Orange contract expires on February 10, 2029, for as long as the County of Orange
  contract is in effect.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES

Kevin Scott, Secretary

Christopher J. Garner, General Manager  Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Vice President Maguire called the meeting to order at 9:00am.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Maguire, Scott, Cordero

Commissioners Absent: Rainey, Shannon

Tai Tseng led the Pledge of Allegiance.

Vice President Maguire spoke.
Chris Garner spoke.

Skip Fulton spoke.
Secretary Scott spoke.
Commissioner Cordero spoke.
Vice President Maguire spoke.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52415  Recommendation to approve February 15, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Treatment Plant (GWTP) Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Project
  (EO-3500), for an additional amount of $125,000, to a new contract total amount
  not to exceed $954,130.

  Chris Pincherli provided the staff report.
  Chris Garner spoke.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Cordero, seconded by Secretary Scott,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Maguire, Scott, Cordero

  Abstain: 0  None

  Enterprises, LLC dba Ferguson Facilities Supply, to furnish and deliver as-needed
  plumbing supplies, on the same terms and conditions afforded to the County of
  Orange, in a total annual amount not to exceed $1,500,000 until the County of

  Tai Tseng provided the staff report.
  Secretary Scott spoke.
  Commissioner Cordero spoke.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Cordero, seconded by Secretary Scott,

  No:  0  None

  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Rainey, Shannon

Richard Anthony spoke.
